items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Tommy didn't have any band. He'd come around there and play with us.

ctx.x: About four or six pieces, around six pieces. You played with Tommy, of course. You made that record. Can you tell me the first time you ever heard Tommy and when you played with him?
Well, I met Tommy, I guess, must have been around 11 or 12. Around 11 or 12. Around the days of when Jack Johnson opened up. 41 West 31st Street.
What did he have, a club or saloon or something?
